finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, threw | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 remaining lines are deprecation warnings only. They name real work like `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher`.

Next: clear those deprecations if you want a fully silent log.
